| Predicted host range | Plasmid proportion (approx.) |
|---|---|
| Genus | ~24% |
| Family | ~11% |
| Order | ~30% |
| Class | ~3% |
| Phylum | ~9% |

These estimates sum to about 100%. The order-level host range is the largest group, and the class-level range is the smallest.
